findings.title: delivery-not-ready: result-only-child is not directly parented by certified material head
findings.requested: Re-establish the current exact-head material freeze and publish a single direct result-only child before independent re-audit.
findings.observed: The prior published head was not a direct child of the material head named by its certificate, so the terminal handoff chain was stale.

findings.title: re-audit source and remediation artifacts belong to a foreign target
findings.requested: Replace active re-audit source/remediation artifacts with data bound to the current repository, work item, pull request, rejection and material head; retain foreign records only as explicitly historical lineage.
findings.observed: The active audit source/remediation artifacts referenced another issue, pull request, material SHA and rejection identity.
